parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, no facility or border restriction, no documented police targeting, and strong official endorsement (senior leaders backing Pride, 2024 protection decrees naming trans people, gender-identity-inclusive health policy) put this above the elevated band. The worst documented feature is tier-3 societal hostility: family- and community-based violence including corrective rape, verbal abuse in public services, and school bullying — reaching visitors only at low frequency, and the 86% figure is a 57-person self-selected sample, not a population rate. Hate-crime law covers orientation but not gender identity, custody rules lack GI safeguards, and enforcement in trans cases is unsourced — thin recourse holds it below 0.75. Weak signals (family-based violence, openly endorsed public trans visibility, no targeting) extrapolate to reduced-but-not-low risk.
